The '''purple stingwort''' was a venomous [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that was native to the shores of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. It used its [[Color/Legends|color]] to attract its prey, which it rendered immobile by exuding a potent [[Poison/Legends|toxin]]. When the poison entered the system of most mammalian [[Species/Legends|species]], it caused excruciating pain and almost instant [[Death/Legends|death]] in lower species. Any [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|being]] coming in contact with the stingwort venom was plunged into anaphylactic shock, which could result in death if not treated immediately.
